rendering.integration_basis: Native real-time DLAA matches the original website capture mode. Retains native resolution/rate, fixed camera settings, render-only convergence, and high-quality encoding. Selected from actual moving-clip comparisons after the authors proposed expensive full path-tracing profiles; proposals are archived without alteration. Long recordings use CRF16 and six-second maximum keyframe intervals to fit the existing GitHub Pages per-file limit; native raster size, frame rate and physical frame cadence remain unchanged. Final recordings require decoded quality and browser-seek verification.
rendering.validation_scope: Moving preview windows validated at native resolution. Complete final recordings still require video, cadence and visual inspection; this profile does not assert zero temporal variation.
